annotation.title_clean: Estratégia de Implantação da Inteligência Artificial pelas Defensorias Públicas do Brasil
annotation.title_en: Strategy for the Implementation of Artificial Intelligence by Brazil's Public Defender Offices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública (Secretaria de Acesso à Justiça); CONDEGE; Defensoria Pública da União
annotation.summary_en: Public consultation (Dec 2023–Jun 2024, now closed) by Brazil's Public Defender Offices, CONDEGE and DPU, with the Ministry of Justice, on a unified strategy for ethically responsible, transparent AI adoption. It covers generative AI, social impacts, human oversight, training and governance. It has no physical or embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Public Defender Offices intend a unified, ethical, transparent and collaborative AI implementation strategy
AI should reduce bureaucratic work and expand access to justice
Human supervision at all necessary stages and continuous staff training are required
Consultation asks 15 questions on impacts, applications, ethical and technical parameters, and governance
Concerns include labor displacement, surveillance and human rights violations
